meta.title: Kai Moreno. Sport climber.
meta.description: Kai Moreno, a sport climber based in Granada, Spain. Fifteen seasons on limestone and the routes that came out of them.

hero.name: Kai Moreno
hero.canvasLabel: A limestone boulder drawn in code. Moving the pointer paints its survey layer.

about.heading: Patience before power.
about.body: Kai Moreno has spent fifteen seasons on limestone, from the gorges outside Granada to the caves of northern Norway. He climbs slowly, reads a wall the way a surveyor reads a valley, and comes back to the same line until it gives. Most of his first ascents took longer to see than to send.

quote.text: “The wall never hurries. I stopped asking it to.”

contact.heading: Let’s find the next line.
contact.body: Films, partnerships, route-setting and talks. Kai answers every message himself, usually from a campsite.

worksPage.title: Climbs. Kai Moreno.
worksPage.heading: Every line, in order.
worksPage.intro: Ten routes that changed how Kai climbs. Grades are French sport grades; the year is the season of the first redpoint.
worksPage.thumbLabel: Rock surface drawn in code for

works.title: Salt and Silence
works.note: Three seasons of attempts on a blank grey shield above the river. The crux is one hold held for far too long.

works.title: The Long Exhale
works.note: Sixty metres of pocketed conglomerate, climbed in one breath and one very long rest.

works.title: Blue Hour
works.note: Sent in the last light of the trip, on blue streaked limestone gone cold enough to stick.

works.title: Quiet Weather
works.note: A granite cave line that waited out two weeks of rain and gave itself up on a still morning.

works.title: Paper Moon
works.note: Tufa pinches and a moonlit lower-off. The first route Kai bolted himself.

works.title: Low Tide Traverse
works.note: Deep-water solo over a falling tide. Every fall meant swimming back to start.

works.title: Granite Hymn
works.note: Thin crimps on an orange wall, best climbed in the cold hour before sunrise.

works.title: Small Hours
works.note: A steep arch climbed by headlamp to dodge the August heat.

works.title: Second Wind
works.note: The first route that needed a plan rather than a good day.

works.title: First Light
works.note: Where it started: a grey slab, a borrowed rope and four days of trying.
